description.plain:
Business problem

Target Industries: Discrete & Process Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Wholesale Distribution, Engineering & Construction.
User Personas: Accounts Payable Lead, Reconciliation Analyst, Procurement
Approver, Warehouse GR Specialist, and Financial Controller.

Disjointed P2P Records: Finance teams waste hours manually cross-referencing supplier bills against SAP Purchase Orders (ME23N) and Goods Receipts (MIGO).
Silent Financial Leakage: Unchecked price variances, tax code discrepancies, and billing for unreceived freight slip through manual spot checks.
Unprioritized Exception Backlogs: AP analysts are overwhelmed by high invoice volumes without algorithmic triage, root-cause explanations, or aging visibility.

description.plain:
BTP prequiste

SAP HANA Cloud (hana-td or hdi-shared plan)
SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Runtime (Node.js 20 buildpack across Approuter and CAP SRV)
SAP HTML5 Application Repository (app-host and app-runtime plans)
SAP Destination Service (lite plan) and XSUAA Authorization Service (application plan)
SAP Build Work Zone Standard Edition

SAP Cloud Connector connected to BTP subaccount with virtual host pointing to ERP port 44300 / 8000.
Standard Gateway Services active: API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV, API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV, API_SUPPLIERINVOICE_PROCESS_SRV.
Technical user authorizations for Purchasing (ME23N), Inventory Documents (MIGO), and Supplier Invoices (MIRO).

description.plain:
Results

80.9% Automated Touchless Match Rate across 162 evaluated enterprise invoices (sample/demo dataset).

Before: Invoice checks require manual comparison across ME23N, MIGO and MIRO screens, taking 3–7 business days per cycle with frequent overbilling leakage.
After: Automated 3-way matching in seconds; 131 clean invoices clear touchless, while manual review is confined to 31 pre-triaged exceptions with full variance
evidence.
